Du löst ein Single-Item Lot-Sizing-Problem mit Kapazitätsrestriktion über 25 Perioden. In jeder Periode kann produziert werden (mit fixen Setup-Kosten, falls produziert wird, plus variablen Produktionskosten pro Einheit), bis zur jeweiligen Kapazitätsgrenze. import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB
import json

# Periodendaten
period_data = {
    "1": {"demand": 34, "setup_cost": 372, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "2": {"demand": 25, "setup_cost": 326, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "3": {"demand": 13, "setup_cost": 154, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "4": {"demand": 50, "setup_cost": 289, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "5": {"demand": 46, "setup_cost": 366, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "6": {"demand": 17, "setup_cost": 301, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "7": {"demand": 26, "setup_cost": 239, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "8": {"demand": 26, "setup_cost": 253, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "9": {"demand": 42, "setup_cost": 448, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "10": {"demand": 37, "setup_cost": 342, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "11": {"demand": 44, "setup_cost": 357, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "12": {"demand": 27, "setup_cost": 325, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "13": {"demand": 45, "setup_cost": 402, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "14": {"demand": 37, "setup_cost": 350, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "15": {"demand": 28, "setup_cost": 465, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "16": {"demand": 45, "setup_cost": 447, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "17": {"demand": 13, "setup_cost": 312, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "18": {"demand": 28, "setup_cost": 141, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "19": {"demand": 28, "setup_cost": 347, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "20": {"demand": 49, "setup_cost": 332, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "21": {"demand": 14, "setup_cost": 107, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "22": {"demand": 40, "setup_cost": 333, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "23": {"demand": 14, "setup_cost": 351, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "24": {"demand": 26, "setup_cost": 366, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "25": {"demand": 17, "setup_cost": 430, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5}
}

# Kapazität pro Periode
capacity = {
    "1": 47, "2": 22, "3": 9, "4": 55, "5": 58, "6": 27, "7": 32, "8": 33, "9": 66,
    "10": 44, "11": 70, "12": 32, "13": 66, "14": 26, "15": 21, "16": 58, "17": 10,
    "18": 42, "19": 25, "20": 56, "21": 14, "22": 30, "23": 21, "24": 32, "25": 22
}

# Modell erstellen
model = gp.Model("Single-Item Lot-Sizing")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Variablen
production = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="production")
setup = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="setup")
inventory = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="inventory")

# Zielfunktion: Gesamtkosten minimieren
model.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(
        period_data[t]["setup_cost"] * setup[t] +
        period_data[t]["prod_cost"] * production[t] +
        period_data[t]["holding_cost"] * inventory[t]
        for t in period_data.keys()
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

# Nebenbedingungen
for t in period_data.keys():
    t_int = int(t)
    # Nachfrage decken
    if t_int == 1:
        model.addConstr(production[t] == period_data[t]["demand"] + inventory[t])
    else:
        model.addConstr(production[t] + inventory[str(t_int - 1)] == period_data[t]["demand"] + inventory[t])
    
    # Kapazitätsbeschränkung
    model.addConstr(production[t] <= capacity[t] * setup[t])

    # Keine negativen Bestände
    model.addConstr(inventory[t] >= 0)

# Optimierung
model.optimize()

# Ergebnisse
production_plan = {t: int(production[t].X) for t in period_data.keys()}
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Ausgabe
result = {
    "production": production_plan,
    "objective_value": objective_value
}

print(json.dumps(result))
